verdict.rationale: Figma's Dev Mode offers inspection and displays code snippets, either autogenerated or true-to-production via Code Connect. Community users confirm it outputs CSS and that assets can be copied as SVG. A community note says Dev Mode moved to a separate license, which suggests access without a full editor seat, but this is not documented first-party. missing for 10: documented measurement/redline inspection, explicit iOS/Android snippet support, first-party confirmation of seat requirements for Dev Mode, documented asset export within Dev Mode.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat

citations.quote: Figma's Dev Mode will display true-to-production code snippets from your design system instead of autogenerated code examples.
Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server
Right Click the icon > Copy/Paste as > Copy as SVG. We use that and just paste it into the codebase.
